svg.desc: 1023 commits across five public projects, 73 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-15 through 2026-11-06 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-06T14:57:36.561Z.
